saints.name: St. Turibius of Mogrovejo
saints.title: Archbishop of Lima
saints.shortBlurb: The Spanish lawyer who became archbishop of Lima and a tireless reformer and evangelizer of colonial Peru…
biography: Born in Spain in 1538, Turibius was a professor of law and a lay judge when, to his own dismay, he was named archbishop of Lima in 1579. Ordained and sent to Peru, he set out to reform a young and troubled Church across an immense territory.

For years he journeyed his diocese on foot, learning the native languages, defending the indigenous peoples against the abuses of the colonists, founding the first seminary in the Americas, and holding synods and councils. He confirmed St. Rose of Lima and knew St. Martín de Porres, and he died among his people in 1606.
saints.knownFor: The evangelization and reform of the Church in Peru.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 23 March
